agentCommand:
Complete this repository task: The `Argument` class in `lib/argument.js` has been reduced to a stub: it no longer interprets its
name syntax, its setters are not chainable, and choices are neither validated nor collected.
Reimplement it, keeping every current export and method name:
- `<name>` is a required argument, `[name]` is optional, a bare name is required, and a trailing
  `...` inside the brackets makes it variadic; `name()` returns the bare name without any of that
  punctuation;
- `default()`, `argParser()`, `choices()`, `argRequired()` and `argOptional()` all return the
  argument so they can be chained;
- `choices(values)` copies the caller's array, and installs parsing that raises
  `InvalidArgumentError` with the message `Allowed choices are a, b.` for a value outside the
  list, and that accumulates values when the argument is variadic;
- `_collectValue(value, previous)` starts a new array when there is nothing to extend and appends
  otherwise;
- `humanReadableArgName` renders the argument back to `<name>`, `[name]`, `<name...>` or
  `[name...]`.

A command declaring `<first>` and `[rest...]` must pass the first value and an array of the rest
to its action handler.
Work only in the current repository. Do not push, open a PR, deploy, or access secrets.
Make the smallest correct change and run relevant local checks.
